answer: The check happens before any reward is counted, never after the coins have gone. Walk the trail by hand: it is short enough to walk and long enough to trip a farm. A farm can rehearse the reef and rehearse the tide, but it cannot rehearse the sparrow, because a year will not rehearse. A single honest proof outweighs a warehouse of masks, and Parchment cutter hide mark stretched on the scraping bench is that proof, written out as each hide is a stretching record witnessed by the master parchmenter. Lock 119 POA away per mask and a farm of 304 masks has 36176 POA frozen before the epoch opens.
